native_evaluator.adaptive_rule: Native quarter/mid/three-quarter refinement: all local rotations <=0.075 degrees, local translations <=0.25mm, all source joint world positions <=0.25mm. Stop unresolved cuts only at adjacent f32 times and retain both original native values. Measured samples are not a continuous mathematical error bound.
native_evaluator.method: Original AnimationClip AssetBundle -> original Avatar -> manual native AnimationClipPlayable Graph; direct local TRS, no muscle approximation
